INSERT INTO transactions
               (member_id, rule_id, period, kind, title, amount_cents, date,
                manual_paid, visibility, bucket, sort_key, created_at, created_by)
           VALUES (?1, NULL, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, 0, ?7, ?8, ?9, ?10, ?11)
           RETURNING id AS "id!: i64"
